question: Which functions and classes defined in this repo's src/ does `rebuild_reference_edges` (src/ibwd/graph/resolution.py) directly call?
result_text:
`rebuild_reference_edges` directly calls nine functions and classes defined in `src/`. I checked the list from the call graph against the function body (`resolution.py:250-338`), and every entry is called there.

| Symbol | Kind | Defined in | Called at |
|---|---|---|---|
| `language_of` | function | `src/ibwd/graph/modules.py:22` | line 259 |
| `Sym` | class | `src/ibwd/graph/resolution.py:46` | line 270 |
| `SymbolIndex` | class | `src/ibwd/graph/resolution.py:80` | line 273 |
| `ModuleResolver` | class | `src/ibwd/graph/modules.py:29` | line 274 |
| `extract_references` | function | `src/ibwd/scanner/references.py:69` | line 285 |
| `_resolve_imports` | function | `src/ibwd/graph/resolution.py:208` | line 291 |
| `SymbolIndex.innermost` | method | `src/ibwd/graph/resolution.py:95` | lines 300 and 314 |
| `resolve_ref` | function | `src/ibwd/graph/resolution.py:113` | lines 301 and 317 |
| `upsert_edge` | function | `src/ibwd/graph/database.py:114` | line 333 |

`rebuild_reference_edges` also defines a nested helper, `add_edge`, and calls it directly (line 296 via a lambda, lines 311 and 327). It isn't defined at module level, so it isn't in the graph. The function also calls `conn.execute`, `dict.fromkeys` and `.commit()`, which are stdlib or sqlite3 rather than repo code.
